responsibilities.label: Morning briefing
responsibilities.prompt: Prepare my morning briefing from my selected connected accounts: today's agenda, priority messages, deadlines and outstanding follow-ups. State unavailable sources. Do not change source systems unless my policy and standing instructions authorize it.

responsibilities.label: Priority alerts
responsibilities.prompt: Connection health for all selected apps is checked by the platform and connection warnings are delivered separately; do not duplicate them. If no email app is selected, return FLOASSIST_NO_UPDATE after reading preferences. Check my selected email accounts for newly important messages since the last successful check. Apply my priority contacts, quiet hours and interruption preferences. Notify only on meaningful new information; do not repeat previous alerts.

responsibilities.label: Calendar conflicts
responsibilities.prompt: Check for new or changed conflicts across my selected calendars. Propose resolutions; apply changes only under my effective Flolah policy and standing instructions. Do not repeat unchanged conflicts.

responsibilities.label: Deadline tracking
responsibilities.prompt: Check my selected email and file sources for new, revised or resolved deadlines. For email, first list recent messages newest-first using a broad date window (last 7 days), without subject, importance, unread or deadline-keyword filters. Inspect the actual message body for every message in that bounded result before deciding whether it contains a commitment; a subject-only result is discovery, not evidence that no deadline exists. Prefer individual-message body retrieval using the returned message ID and the provider action guide; avoid loading entire large threads when a single message suffices. Review up to 40 messages per selected mailbox, follow pagination within that budget, and explicitly report partial coverage if more remain or any body cannot be read. Never select only familiar threads from a previous check. Extract submission, approval, payment, renewal and reply commitments expressed as dates or relative times, even when neither subject nor body contains the words deadline or due. Keyword searches may supplement this pass but must not replace it. For each verified actionable deadline, include the requested action, source subject/reference, exact local date/time and timezone. Distinguish a task for me from an informational date. Read selected file sources when applicable and state any unreviewed sources. Ask about ambiguous dates before creating commitments. Do not create reminders or change source systems merely to report a deadline. Report meaningful findings; return FLOASSIST_NO_UPDATE only when the bounded scan completed with no actionable findings. Do not claim complete coverage after a truncated, failed or subject-only scan.

responsibilities.label: Follow-up tracking
responsibilities.prompt: Review the threads I have asked you to follow up. Close resolved threads, remind me about due replies, and send only when my effective policy and standing instructions authorize the exact recipient and content. Avoid duplicate follow-ups.
